description: Proposed Change of Use of part ground floor and upper floors from Office (Class E) to an 8-bed Apart-Hotel (Class C1) with associated internal alterations (Application for Listed Building Consent)(Related to Application ref. 48534/APP/2026/538).
decision_conditions: The works hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.
